vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Tesla LH/RH (left/right) = the vehicle's own left/right: LH = UK nearside (passenger side), RH = UK offside (driver side). Pre-Highland (2019 to late 2023) and Highland facelift (late 2023 onwards) parts differ: every entry says which, or that the source does not say. Tesla numbers take the form NNNNNNN-RR-L (revision suffixes such as -00-C / -00-D, and service or paint versions such as -S0- / -E0- / -11-); some listings drop the hyphens (e.g. 151495200D) and are recorded exactly as written in the source. Paint-matched parts (bumper covers, mirror covers, parking sensors) and wheels are variants. Headlamps: numbers listed for RHD / UK cars are marked UK; the LH 1514952 units were not stated RHD (market unknown), although their RH counterparts 1514953 are listed for RHD cars. Rear lamps: North American and UK/EU lamps may differ (rear indicator colour), so check the lamp is UK/EU spec. Ultrasonic parking sensors apply only to earlier pre-Highland cars (Highland has none). Numbers were read from web-search result titles and extracts of eBay UK listings; page fetches were blocked by this session's network policy and no Tesla parts-catalogue page was used. Almost all listings are used parts, so no prices were recorded. Numbers were left out where listings conflicted or gave no full number (e.g. bare 1077397 / 1077398 tail lamps, Highland tail lamps 1691498 / 1691500, mirror cover 1092292-00-D, older TPMS sensors of unstated frequency). No frunk lid (bonnet) or Highland headlamp number was found. Research stopped at the search budget (20 searches). Verify every number by VIN.
